lines.en: label dormwarsfive7:
scene noonsky
Not fully understanding what all of this Death Ball stuff is about, I’m left to just relocate once more and hope I don’t soon become the last remaining member of my family.
lines.zh: 没完全搞懂这个死亡球到底是什么名堂，我只能再一次转移阵地，并祈祷自己不会很快成为家族里仅存的最后一人。

lines.en: I guess losing Molly would kind of suck too. I’d feel mean if I didn’t at least mention her here as well.
lines.zh: 我想失去 Molly 也挺糟的。要是在这儿提都不提她，我会觉得自己很刻薄。

lines.en: I’m feeling good about one thing, though — and it’s that Ami gets to compete against one of the few girls who at least doesn’t seem to have anything against her.
lines.zh: 不过有一件事让我挺欣慰——那就是 Ami 的对手，至少是那少数几个看起来对她没什么芥蒂的女孩之一。

lines.en: I’m still not really sure how she’s getting along at school without me nowadays. She doesn’t talk much about it.
lines.zh: 我到现在还是不太清楚，如今没有我在，她在学校过得怎么样。她很少提起。

lines.en: But based merely on the way I’ve seen the other girls look at her, I don’t think it’s good.
lines.zh: 但光是从我看到的别的女生看她的眼神来判断，我觉得不太好。

lines.en: It’s deserved, I guess. She did openly air her feelings for me out in front of literally everyone. And...threaten to dismember them.
lines.zh: 大概是她自找的吧。她毕竟当着所有人的面公开表白了对我的感情。还……威胁要把她们大卸八块。

lines.en: But that doesn’t mean I have to be happy about her having a hard time.
lines.zh: 但那不代表我就该为她过得艰难而高兴。

lines.en: I just wish I got to control what is reset and what isn’t. If I could do that, I’d send her back to before she trashed her reputation.
lines.zh: 我只希望能由我掌控什么被重置、什么不被重置。如果能做到，我会把她送回她毁掉自己名声之前。

lines.en: I’d also resurrect her mom and her best friend and have a lot of sex with both of them because I am indecisive and sad.
lines.zh: 我还会复活她妈妈和她最好的朋友，然后和她们俩都做很多次爱，因为我优柔寡断又悲伤。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo1
Anyway, I’m here now. And I’m still not really sure what’s going on.
lines.zh: 总之，我现在人在这儿。而我依然不太清楚到底发生了什么。

lines.en: : How’d that band get up there? Nobody’s supposed to have keys to the roof.
lines.zh: : 那支乐队是怎么上去的？屋顶的钥匙不该在任何人手里啊。

lines.en: : I think a more pertinent question is why is that band up there?
lines.zh: : 我觉得更贴切的问题是，那支乐队为什么会在那上面？

lines.en: : That’s Good Kid! They're Noriko's friends. And they provided the soundtrack for last year’s festivities — which the two of you missed when your soul gems became too clouded.
lines.zh: : 那是 Good Kid！她们是 Noriko 的朋友。去年的庆典配乐就是她们做的——你们俩因为灵魂宝石污浊得太厉害，错过了。

lines.en: : I guess it makes sense if Noriko has a key to the roof. She seems like the type to have connections like that.
lines.zh: : 如果 Noriko 有屋顶钥匙，那就说得通了。她看起来就是那种会有这种门路的人。

lines.en: : Sensei! Do the thing!
lines.zh: : Sensei！来做那个！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo2
: What thing? I still don’t understand why you guys wanted me to stand here to begin with.
lines.zh: : 做哪个？我还是不明白你们为什么一开始要我站在这儿。

lines.en: : Am I playing the game too?
lines.zh: : 我也要参加这个游戏吗？

lines.en: : No! You’re just here to explain it and tell everybody the rules!
lines.zh: : 不！你只是来这儿解释游戏、告诉大家规则的！

lines.en: : But I don’t know the rules. I wasn’t here last year.
lines.zh: : 可我不知道规则啊。去年我不在。

lines.en: : I believe that is specifically why you were chosen, Sir!
lines.zh: : 我相信，正是因为这个才选了你，先生！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo3
: ‘Tis no normal ball — that bulbous orb of decay. It’s large enough to crush a small city and leaves behind a trail of corpses in its shadowy wake!
lines.zh: : 那不是普通的球——那颗臃肿的腐朽之球。它大到足以碾碎一座小城，所过之处，在它阴影之下留下一串尸体！

lines.en: : There can be no rules to govern its existence, Sir! You are fighting a losing battle too! Just as we are.
lines.zh: : 没有任何规则能约束它的存在，先生！你打的也是一场必败之战！就像我们一样。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo4
: Sure, Molly. I’m sure that’s just as true as every other delusion of grandeur you’ve hurled at me over the course of our shared existence.
lines.zh: : 当然，Molly。我相信那和你我相识以来抛给我的其他所有妄自尊大的幻想一样真实。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo5
: Uhh...Dad?
lines.zh: : 呃……爸爸？

lines.en: : What, Ami?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Ami？

lines.en: : You might want to open your eyes for a second.
lines.zh: : 你大概该睁开眼睛看一秒。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo6
: What the fuck is that thing?
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿到底是什么鬼东西？

lines.en: : ‘Tis fate itself, Sir! Congealed into a single spherical mass that must be defeated by any means necessary!
lines.zh: : 那是命运本身，先生！凝结成了一个球形的实体，必须以任何必要的手段将其击败！

lines.en: : Greetings once more, girls of 1-A! Has Senpai explained the rules yet?!
lines.zh: : 又见面了，1-A 的姑娘们！Senpai 讲完规则了吗？！

lines.en: : Not even close!
lines.zh: : 差得远呢！

lines.en: : Great! Then we’re just about ready to go!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那我们差不多可以开始了！

lines.en: : Imani! I don’t like the way your alligator is staring at me! I do like the way it wears a top hat, though! I feel so conflicted and so tired all at once!
lines.zh: : Imani！我不喜欢你那条短吻鳄看我的眼神！不过我喜欢它戴礼帽的样子！我又矛盾又累，两种感觉一起涌上来！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo7
: Rin! Make up for your mother’s fear and inability to identify reptiles by shouting out the trick I taught you to decipher the difference between alligators and crocodiles last year!
lines.zh: : Rin！用我去年教你的那个诀窍来弥补你母亲的恐惧和分不清爬行动物的无能吧——大喊出区分短吻鳄和鳄鱼的方法！

lines.en: : Ooh! I remember this! V is for vcrocodile and Catherine has a V-shaped snout thing!
lines.zh: : 哦！我记得这个！V 代表 vcrocodile，而 Catherine 有个 V 形的吻部！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo8
: Ooooh, that makes a lot of sense.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，这下说得通多了。

lines.en: : Senpai! Would you please do the honors of-
lines.zh: : Senpai！请你来做那个——

lines.en: scene deathballtwo9
: Wait, where’d he go?
lines.zh: : 等等，他去哪儿了？

lines.en: scene deathballtwo10
: Aaah! My dad turned into an outline! The death ball’s power is immeasurable!
lines.zh: : 啊！我爸爸变成一道轮廓了！死亡球的力量深不可测！

lines.en: : No, Ami! He merely escaped! You can trust me! I’ve been reading subtitles my whole life!
lines.zh: : 不，Ami！他只是逃走了！你可以相信我！我读了一辈子的字幕！

lines.en: : I’m over here. I just want no part of this.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿。我只是不想掺和这件事。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo11
: He’s also right over there! He just wants no part of this!
lines.zh: : 他也在那边！他只是不想掺和这件事！

lines.en: : Traitor! Defend your daughter from the all-destroying orb!
lines.zh: : 叛徒！保护你女儿，别让那颗全灭之球得逞！

lines.en: : And her friend as well! It’s significantly more imposing now that it’s setting in that I won’t be on the sidelines this time!
lines.zh: : 也保护她的朋友！想到这次我不再是场边看客，它就显得格外有压迫感了！

lines.en: : Whistle incoming! Cover your ears if your name is Miku!
lines.zh: : 哨子来了！叫 Miku 的捂住耳朵！

lines.en: : I think Miku’s still back at the-
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Miku 还在——

lines.en: scene deathballtwo12
: AAAAH! MY EARS!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我的耳朵！

lines.en: : CAN WE NOT INVEST IN A QUIETER WHISTLE?!
lines.zh: : 我们就不能买个安静点的哨子吗？！

lines.en: : LOOK ALIVE OR DIE GIRLS! THE LAST ONE STANDING IS THE WINNER OF DEATH BALL ROUND 2!
lines.zh: : 打起精神否则就死吧，姑娘们！活到最后的，就是死亡球第二轮的胜者！

lines.en: : AND BE CAREFUL! THE DEATH BALL HAS GAINED CONSCIOUS THOUGHT!
lines.zh: : 而且要小心！死亡球已经获得了自主意识！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo13
: It’s WHAT?!
lines.zh: : 它什么？！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo14
: It can teleport too?!
lines.zh: : 它还能瞬移？！

lines.en: : The death ball peers deep into Ami’s mind! It eats away at her soul!
lines.zh: : 死亡球正窥视 Ami 心灵的深处！它在啃食她的灵魂！

lines.en: : No! I need my soul!
lines.zh: : 不！我需要我的灵魂！

lines.en: : And I need to know how Berserk ends! Bye, Ami!
lines.zh: : 而我需要知道《剑风传奇》的结局！再见了，Ami！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo15
: COWARD!
lines.zh: : 懦夫！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo16
scene deathballtwo17
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo18
: That’s right, girls! Flee from the death ball! Survive by any means necessary because we’ve learned by now that even throwing it into the sun won’t kill it!
lines.zh: : 没错，姑娘们！逃离死亡球！不择手段地活下去，因为我们已经知道，就算把它扔进太阳也杀不死它！

lines.en: : Are we sure this is safe?
lines.zh: : 我们确定这安全吗？

lines.en: : No, but I’m pretty sure that’s the point.
lines.zh: : 不确定，不过我猜那才是重点。

lines.en: : I’m just glad I don’t have to worry about my daughter being killed this time.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴这次不用担心我女儿被杀了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I have to worry about that for mine, so it sort of fucks with what I was thinking earlier about how happy I was she’s going up against Molly.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我得替我女儿担心，所以这多少打乱了我先前「很高兴她的对手是 Molly」的想法。

lines.en: : On the bright side, if she does die, I’m almost 100%% sure there will be a documentary about it.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，如果她真死了，我几乎 100%% 确定会有人拍部纪录片。

lines.en: : Oh, good. That makes everything better.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。那一切就都变好了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I’ve never been good at cheering people up. Just ask Yuki.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我从来都不擅长安慰人。去问 Yuki 就知道了。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo19
: You talked to her?
lines.zh: : 你跟她聊过了？

lines.en: : Since when? The near-OD thing that time she busted into the apartment?
lines.zh: : 从什么时候开始？是她那次闯进公寓差点用药过量之后？

lines.en: : Just...recently.
lines.zh: : 就是……最近。

lines.en: : Yeah. I drag her to the gym with me sometimes. She ain’t doin’ so hot.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我偶尔会拽她一起去健身房。她状态不太好。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo20
: Yumi’s stopped goin’ to see her too.
lines.zh: : Yumi 也不再去看她了。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo21
: She...has?
lines.zh: : 她……不去了吗？

lines.en: : Are we seriously playing this fucking game again? Have we learned absolutely nothing?
lines.zh: : 我们真的又要玩这个该死的游戏？我们到底有没有吸取哪怕一点点教训？

lines.en: : Yeah. Think it’s really weighing on her too.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我想那件事也确实压在她心上。

lines.en: : Don’t run from it! The death ball can only be defeated by love! Why does no one understand that but me?!
lines.zh: : 别躲！死亡球只能被爱击败！为什么除了我没人明白这一点？！

lines.en: : Yuki says a lot of shit about how bad of a parent she is. And...I’m not really gonna disagree since I can’t even fathom abandoning Rin.
lines.zh: : Yuki 老说自己是多么糟糕的一个母亲。而且……我真的没法反驳，毕竟我连抛弃 Rin 这件事都无法想象。

lines.en: : My competitive spirit is suddenly overflowing. Tag me in, Emerald Guardian. I will throw the ball to a more distant star this time.
lines.zh: : 我的竞争之心突然满溢而出。让我上场吧，翡翠卫士。这次我要把球扔到更远的星星上去。

lines.en: : But it’s easy to tell how seriously she regrets what she did. And she does want a relationship with Yumi.
lines.zh: : 但很容易看出她对自己做过的事有多后悔。她是真的想和 Yumi 修复关系。

lines.en: : That sort of thing just...can’t be one sided, though. So Yuki’s either gotta try reaching out to her or just...lie in the bed she made.
lines.zh: : 只是那种事……不可能只靠单方面。所以 Yuki 要么试着主动联系她，要么就……自食其果。

lines.en: : That’s all you’ve heard, though? She hasn’t told you anything else?
lines.zh: : 可你就听到这些吗？她没跟你说别的？

lines.en: : She didn’t even tell me that. I figured it out on my own. Are you impressed?
lines.zh: : 那些她连提都没提。是我自己看出来的。你佩服吗？

lines.en: : ...Akira?
lines.zh: : ……Akira？

lines.en: scene deathballtwo22
: Hah...hah...hah...Molly...uses...an escape rope! Ten escape ropes! Fly! Surf! Whatever gets me...away from this thing!
lines.zh: : 哈啊……哈啊……哈啊……Molly……使用……逃脱绳！十条逃脱绳！飞翔术！冲浪术！只要能让我……离这玩意儿远点什么都行！

lines.en: : There are...apartments...just outside of the soccer field! We can...take shelter...in one of those!
lines.zh: : 足球场外面……有公寓！我们可以……躲进其中一间！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo23
: You seek to form a truce here at the brink of our deaths?!
lines.zh: : 你在濒死之际想与我结成同盟？！

lines.en: : I don’t know any other DM’s! I can’t afford to lose you until the campaign is over!
lines.zh: : 我不认识别的城主！在战役结束之前，我可不能失去你！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo24
: Surely I mean more to you than just my abilities?!
lines.zh: : 我对你而言，难道就只有能力上的价值吗？！

lines.en: : Yeah! Sure! If that’s what makes you happy!
lines.zh: : 对！当然！如果那么说能让你开心的话！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo25
: What’s the strategy then?! Because Tuxedo Mask isn’t going to swoop in and save the day for us here, Ami!
lines.zh: : 那战术是什么？！因为这次可没有夜礼服假面从天而降来救我们，Ami！

lines.en: : There’s always a chance he will! I’ll never give up hope! Just distract the ball while I get away!
lines.zh: : 他总有可能会来的！我永远不会放弃希望！你只管引开那个球，我趁机逃走！

lines.en: : Then what will becomes of me once you’ve escaped?!
lines.zh: : 那你逃走之后，我又会变成什么样？！

lines.en: : I don’t know! Soup, maybe?!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！也许变成汤？！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo26
: Irish soup?! When there’s a Japanese alternative right beside me?! YOU distract the ball, Arborea! I will escape instead! My people aren’t known for their soup!
lines.zh: : 爱尔兰汤？！明明我身边就有个日本选项？！你去引开那颗球，Arborea！这次换我逃！我族人可不以汤闻名！

lines.en: : Wow. Those two are so loud that I can hear them from all the way up here.
lines.zh: : 哇。那两个人的声音大得我在这么高的地方都能听见。

lines.en: : At least it looks like Ami is having fun again...
lines.zh: : 至少看起来 Ami 又开心起来了……

lines.en: scene deathballtwo27
: What??? Can you speak up, Sana???
lines.zh: : 什么？？？你能大声点吗，Sana？？？

lines.en: : Am I really so quiet that you can hear them but not me?...
lines.zh: : 我真的这么小声吗？你能听见她们却听不见我？……

lines.en: : I can’t hear you! You’re going to have to-
lines.zh: : 我听不见！你得——

lines.en: scene deathballtwo28
: I said it’s good Ami is having fun! I was starting to worry about her!
lines.zh: : 我说 Ami 能开心起来真好！我都开始担心她了！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo29
: Oh, really? I didn’t know you guys were that close. That’s really nice, Sana.
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？我不知道你们俩这么要好。真好啊，Sana。

lines.en: : I just have a lot in common with her. People can get...different when they lose someone.
lines.zh: : 我只是和她有很多共同点。人失去某个人之后……是会变的。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo30
: Yeah...I’m fortunate enough to not really know what that’s like. I guess I’m glad that Ami’s doing a little better now, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我很幸运，不太懂那是什么感觉。不过我想，Ami 现在能好一点，我还是挺高兴的。

lines.en: : I’m just worried Sensei might be thinking about her a little too much now. Which wouldn’t be that bad if she didn’t want to fuck his brains out.
lines.zh: : 我只是担心 Sensei 现在可能有点太把她放在心上了。如果她不想把他脑子操出来，那倒也没那么糟。

lines.en: : I’d probably want to fuck Sensei if he was my dad too...
lines.zh: : 如果 Sensei 是我爸爸，我大概也想操他……

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’re a freak. You don’t count.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你是个怪人。你不算数。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo31
: You masturbate to ponies.
lines.zh: : 你对着小马自慰。

lines.en: : That...not...all the time! No kink-shaming on the roof!
lines.zh: : 那……不是……一直都这样！屋顶上禁止羞辱别人的癖好！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo32
: I’m not shaming you. I just think people might be a little too hard on Ami. I think it’s nice to love someone as much as she loves Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我没有羞辱你。我只是觉得大家对 Ami 可能有点太苛刻了。我觉得能像她爱 Sensei 那样深爱一个人，挺好的。

lines.en: : And the...threatening to dismember anyone who gets close to him thing?
lines.zh: : 那……威胁要把靠近他的任何人砍成碎块这件事呢？

lines.en: : We all want to do that. She’s just the first one to say it out loud.
lines.zh: : 我们也都想那么做。她只是第一个说出口的。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo33
: No, Sana. We don’t all want to-
lines.zh: : 不，Sana。我们不是全都想——

lines.en: : Uh-oh. I think the death ball is about to explode.
lines.zh: : 哎呀糟了。我觉得死亡球要爆炸了。

lines.en: : There’s no way the death ball is about to-
lines.zh: : 死亡球不可能要——

lines.en: scene deathballtwo34
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo35
: S-S-STAY BACK, DEATH BALL! I...I’M WARNING YOU! I’LL CAST SHADOW WORD: DEATH!
lines.zh: : 退……退后，死亡球！我……我在警告你！我要施放暗言术：死亡！

lines.en: : It has “death” in its name! That obviously won’t do anything but make it stronger, Molly!
lines.zh: : 它名字里就有「死亡」！那除了让它变强以外什么用都没有，Molly！

lines.en: : Then...Shadow Word: Pain! Shadow Word: Leave Me Alone & Return to the Sun!
lines.zh: : 那……暗言术：痛！暗言术：离我远点滚回太阳里去！

lines.en: : There is...no way this is how it ends for me...killed by a ball...after all I’ve been through...
lines.zh: : 我不可能……就这么结束……被一个球杀死……在我经历了这一切之后……

lines.en: : We can still live! There must be a chance! There must be something we can do!
lines.zh: : 我们还能活！一定还有机会！一定还有什么我们能做的！

lines.en: : That’s what I’ve been trying to tell you guys! The death ball is weak to love!
lines.zh: : 这就是我一直想告诉你们的！死亡球弱点是爱！

lines.en: : Shadow Word: Love! Shadow Word: Hug! Shadow Word...Breed?!
lines.zh: : 暗言术：爱！暗言术：拥抱！暗言术……配种？！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo36
: Shadow Word: Tell Us What To Do If You’re So Smart, Uta!
lines.zh: : 暗言术：你要是这么聪明倒是告诉我们该怎么办啊，Uta！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo37
: Kiss!
lines.zh: : 亲嘴！

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : The death ball knows nothing but hate and destruction! And it’s because of that that we misunderstand what it truly wants!
lines.zh: : 死亡球除了憎恨与毁灭什么都不知道！正因为如此，我们才误解了它真正想要的东西！

lines.en: : To know there is more to life than this! To know that love is real!
lines.zh: : 想知道生命中还有比这更多的东西！想知道爱是真实存在的！

lines.en: : Just have Tsuneyo fuckin’ throw it again.
lines.zh: : 让 Tsuneyo 他妈的再扔一次不就行了。

lines.en: : Put me in, coach. I’m ready to play.
lines.zh: : 让我上场，教练。我准备好了。

lines.en: : Uta — is it possible that, like me, you maybe just want to see as many girls kiss as possible?
lines.zh: : Uta——有没有可能，就像我一样，你只是想看尽量多的女生接吻？

lines.en: : Yes! It’s possible I’m wrong and that the death ball crushes you while you are kissing! But I still think you guys should try!
lines.zh: : 有可能！也许我错了，你们亲到一半就被死亡球碾碎！但我还是觉得你们该试试！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo38
: It’s coming closer, Arborea!
lines.zh: : 它越来越近了，Arborea！

lines.en: : I’m not blind, Molly! I can see it!
lines.zh: : 我又没瞎，Molly！我看得见！

lines.en: : I understand that! But having nothing but action shots and zero dialogue in a visual novel would not make for a very exciting game! Or a novel at all for that matter!
lines.zh: : 我明白！可一部视觉小说里只有动作立绘、零对白，是做不成让人兴奋的游戏的！那根本连小说都算不上！

lines.en: : Cool! Kiss me!
lines.zh: : 酷！亲我！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo39
: Wait! Really?!
lines.zh: : 等等！真的吗？！

lines.en: : I refuse to die here! I have so much more I need to do!
lines.zh: : 我死也不死在这儿！我还有太多事没做！

lines.en: : But Sensei’s right there!
lines.zh: : 可 Sensei 就在那边！

lines.en: : And we both know he’d like it! Which should provide further incentive to proceed if wanting to avoid death is not enough for you!
lines.zh: : 而我们俩都知道他会喜欢的！如果「不想死」还不足以成为你的动力，那这个总该够了！

lines.en: : Have fun, you two.
lines.zh: : 玩得开心，你俩。

lines.en: : Just to be sure — this isn’t a confession, right?! We’re doing this out of necessity?!
lines.zh: : 先确认一下——这不是告白对吧？！我们是出于无奈才这么做的？！

lines.en: : Does it really matter?!
lines.zh: : 那真的重要吗？！

lines.en: : It does to the people who tag the game! Sex under the necessity is too niche of a category to just tack on without properly establishing ground rules of what necessity means!
lines.zh: : 对给游戏打标签的人来说很重要！「出于无奈的性」是个太小众的分类，不能不好好界定「无奈」的定义就随便往上贴！

lines.en: : Who said anything about sex?!
lines.zh: : 谁说要性了？！

lines.en: : Oh! Sorry! This is just a lot like a dream I had once! I must have mixed things up!
lines.zh: : 哦！抱歉！只是这很像我有过的一个梦！我一定是搞混了！

lines.en: : Guys! There’s not much time left! You need to act now or-
lines.zh: : 各位！没多少时间了！你们现在就得行动，不然——

lines.en: scene deathballtwo40
: Mmnh!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯！

lines.en: : Mnhmhm!??!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯！？？！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo41
: YES! FINALLY! SOMEBODY DID IT WHEN I TOLD THEM TO!
lines.zh: : 成了！终于！总算有人照我说的做了！

lines.en: : I never thought I- wait...did my plan actually work?
lines.zh: : 我从没想过我——等等……我的计划真的奏效了？

lines.en: : Did...did it stop moving?
lines.zh: : 它……它停下不动了？

lines.en: : There! Are you happy, death ball?! Is girl-on-girl action what you wanted all along?!
lines.zh: : 喏！你满意了吧，死亡球？！难道你从头到尾想要的就是女生亲女生？！

lines.en: : Y-Yeah! You pervy...little...orb! I bet you liked that, didn’t you?!
lines.zh: : 对……对啊！你这变态的……小……球！我猜你很喜欢那样吧？！

lines.en: : Don’t make it weird.
lines.zh: : 别搞得那么奇怪。

lines.en: : Sorry. I’ve never kissed a friend without it ruining everything before.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我以前从没亲过朋友，还能不把一切搞砸的。

lines.en: : Hey, we’re good now. I’m glad to see you’ve moved on to Ami instead.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们现在没事了。我很高兴看到你已经转向 Ami 了。

lines.en: : Imani, what now? The ball just, like...froze.
lines.zh: : Imani，现在怎么办？那个球就这么……冻住了。

lines.en: : Wait, Rika.
lines.zh: : 等等，Rika。

lines.en: : Wait...
lines.zh: : 等等……

lines.en: scene deathballtwo42
: What...What’s happening?
lines.zh: : 什么……发生什么了？

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: : I think it’s...going home...
lines.zh: : 我觉得它……要回家了……

lines.en: scene deathballtwo43
: I now understand...
lines.zh: : 我现在明白了……

lines.en: : The meaning of life...
lines.zh: : 生命的意义……

lines.en: : Has always been lesbians...
lines.zh: : 一直都是女同性恋……

lines.en: scene deathballtwo44
: Amen.
lines.zh: : 阿门。

lines.en: : Goodbye, old friend...you’re in a better place now.
lines.zh: : 永别了，老朋友……你现在去了一个更好的地方。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo45
: Yeah! So that was weird. But nobody died, so I call that a win.
lines.zh: : 是啊！那可真够怪的。不过没人死，所以我算它赢了。

lines.en: : The death ball has a 0%% kill rate when it comes to class 1-A. And that’s probably a world record, so you guys should be proud.
lines.zh: : 死亡球对 1-A 班的击杀率是 0%%。那大概是世界纪录了，所以你们应该感到骄傲。

lines.en: : I didn’t get a chance to ask because I was too busy trying not to die and also kissing Molly, but why is there a crocodile here?
lines.zh: : 我刚才忙着不让自己死掉、还要亲 Molly，所以没机会问——为什么会有一只鳄鱼在这儿？

lines.en: : Oh, this is just Catherine. She’s been eating all of the extra arms I ordered and will probably return to the swamp whenever we run out.
lines.zh: : 哦，这只是 Catherine。她一直在吃我订购的所有多余手臂，等我们吃完了她大概就会回沼泽去。

lines.en: : Wow. Last year’s Dorm Wars really were weird, weren’t they?
lines.zh: : 哇。去年的宿舍战争真的很离谱，是吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. I was going through it back then. You know how it is, Ami.
lines.zh: : 是啊。那阵子我过得挺糟的。你懂的，Ami。

lines.en: : I sure do, Miss Imai. And I imagine I’d be feeding body parts to a crocodile as well if I had access to both of those things.
lines.zh: : 我当然懂，Imai 老师。而且我想，如果我手头同时有那两样东西，我大概也会拿身体部位去喂鳄鱼。

lines.en: : So, now that the unholy sphere has been vanquished, what becomes of the competition? And what loot did it drop?
lines.zh: : 那么，既然这颗亵渎的球体已被消灭，比赛接下来如何？它掉了什么战利品？

lines.en: : Just some gold we’re putting toward the next Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 就一些金币，我们会投到下一届宿舍战争里去。

lines.en: : As far as the competition goes, though, we don’t really have a winner.
lines.zh: : 至于比赛本身嘛，我们其实没有胜者。

lines.en: : The idea was to give the point to whoever the last girl standing was and you both went down at the same time. And seeing as you’re both still on your feet now-
lines.zh: : 本来的打算是把这一分给活到最后的那个人，可你们俩是同时倒下的。而鉴于你们现在都还站着——

lines.en: scene deathballtwo46
: Why, yes. It does appear that we have found ourselves in quite the conundrum given our quick thinking and wit.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，是的。凭借我们敏捷的思维与机智，看来我们确实陷入了相当棘手的僵局。

lines.en: scene deathballtwo47
: But! If I may offer a suggestion, rerunning the D&D scenario from earlier would take virtually no preparation at all given that the characters and plot have already been-
lines.zh: : 不过！恕我进言，重跑一遍先前的龙与地下城剧本几乎不需要任何准备，毕竟角色和剧情都已经——

lines.en: scene deathballtwo48
: Ah?!
scene deathballtwo49
: MNGH! What?! Whaaaat?! What happened?!
lines.zh: : 唔嗯！什么？！什——什么？！发生什么了？！

lines.en: : Uh-oh! Looks like Molly isn’t on her feet anymore! Which means that Ami is the winner!
lines.zh: : 哎呀糟了！看来 Molly 已经不再站着了！也就是说 Ami 是胜者！

lines.en: scene deathballtwo50
: A round of applause for Ami, everyone! Congratulations on winning your first contest back from the IL! And you only had to kiss one girl to do it.
lines.zh: : 大家为 Ami 鼓掌！恭喜你从 IL 回来后赢下第一场比赛！而且你只亲了一个女生就做到了。

lines.en: : Phbhbhthtt! There’s so much...sand in my mouth now! Is this the thanks I get for lending you my lips?!
lines.zh: : 噗呸呸！我嘴里现在全是……沙子！这就是我借你嘴唇得到的报答吗？！

lines.en: : Sorry, Molly. All’s fair in the game of love and death ball.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，Molly。在爱与死亡球的博弈里，一切都是公平的。

lines.en: : You might want to get up soon though, or Imani’s crocodile might eat you.
lines.zh: : 不过你最好快点起来，不然 Imani 的鳄鱼可能会吃掉你。

lines.en: scene black
: Gyaaaah! ‘Tis Rotgrip all over again! Stay back, you fiend!
lines.zh: : 呀啊啊！这简直是 Rotgrip 重现！滚开，你这恶兽！

lines.en: : Aww...it’s okay, Catherine. She didn’t mean it.
lines.zh: : 哎呀……没事的，Catherine。她不是有意的。

lines.en: : Here. Have an arm.
lines.zh: : 给。吃条手臂。

lines.en: : Oh, so you just carry them around? That’s really cool, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : 哦，所以你就随身带着？真酷，Imai 老师。

lines.en: : Thanks, Ami! Here. High five.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Ami！来。击个掌。

lines.en: : Ooh! Fun!
lines.zh: : 哦！好玩！

lines.en: : Right?! But, as fun as it is, it can’t last forever! Because the time has come-
lines.zh: : 对吧？！不过再好玩，也不可能永远玩下去！因为时机已到——
